{{Quote|I am Ephran Zell. For generations, my family has studied the tombs of Korriban, traveling from one to the next to learn the history of the Sith.|Ephran Zell introduces himself to Sith acolytes outside Tulak Hord's tomb on Korriban|<ref name="The Hate Machine" />}}
'''Ephran Zell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who resided on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've studied this tomb for years--slept on its stones and dreamed of its depths. Now, I need assistance to solve its final mystery.|Ephran Zell, to Sith acolytes outside Tulak Hord's tomb on Korriban|<ref name="The Hate Machine" />}}
Born into a long line of researchers and [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Ephran Zell served the Empire by assisting in the excavation of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Working inside the [[Tomb of Tulak Hord|tomb]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]], Zell longed to uncover the secrets of Hord's ancient [[Red Engine]], a machine of untold power. According with Zell, Tulak Hord's tomb was build with exact specification provided by Hord himself to hold the Red Engine. While most scholars at the nearby [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] believed the machine to be incomplete, Zell had evidence that those Sith who had tried to activate it had failed to fully understand the mystery of the engine. While Zell was not an educated man, he believed that the machine needed blood of the tomb's beasts and the hatred of a true Sith to activate the machine. When a passing [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] agreed to undertake Zell's challenge of venturing into the tomb and turning on the machine, Zell was eventually proven right when the Acolyte returned with the hidden teachings from the machine.<ref name="The Hate Machine" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ephran Zell appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was the quest giver for a Heroic mission on Korriban for both Sith player classes.<ref name="The Hate Machine" />
